entries.research_question: Do instruction-tuned LLMs match human grammatical/rhetorical style variation across genres?
entries.main_finding: Instruction-tuned models favour dense noun-heavy style; participial ~2-5x, nominalization ~1.5-2.1x, phrasal coordination ~1.4-1.9x, agentless passives underused, 14 vocab items ~84-171x; authors frame as revision opportunities not authorship test
entries.limitations: English only; 2024-era models; tagged per-1k-token rates not comparable to regex proxies; cross-model generalisation harder
entries.does_not_justify: quotas, bans, authorship verdicts, proxy-to-paper numeric comparison

entries.venue: Variation Across Speech and Writing (CUP); 1995; Conrad & Biber
entries.research_question: Along which co-occurring feature dimensions do registers vary?
entries.main_finding: No single formal/informal axis; features work in clusters with functional underpinnings
entries.limitations: English-calibrated; Not-AI uses dimensions interpretively, no factor analysis

entries.research_question: Can ChatGPT mimic student reader-engagement in argumentative essays?
entries.main_finding: Students richer engagement esp. questions/asides; ChatGPT fewer interactional markers, more shared-knowledge appeals
entries.limitations: one task/population; full effect tables not re-verified (abstract+repository record checked)
entries.supports: engagement review in argumentative/student genres only
entries.does_not_justify: universal question/aside quotas; forcing first person elsewhere

entries.main_finding: AI fewer stance expressions, narrower repertoire, rigid formulaic bundles

entries.research_question: How widespread is LLM-assisted writing in biomedical literature?
entries.main_finding: Abrupt style-word rise (delves r~28, underscores r~13.8, showcasing r~10.7); lower bound >=13.5% of 2024 abstracts LLM-processed
entries.limitations: corpus-level only; cannot classify individual docs; marker list shifts
entries.does_not_justify: word bans or single-word authorship proof

entries.research_question: Which lexical-diversity indices are valid and length-robust?
entries.main_finding: MTLD length-invariant in tests; HD-D viable vocd-D alternative; use more than one index
entries.limitations: contexts differ from Not-AI genres; short texts still unstable
entries.supports: stdlib MTLD+HD-D alongside TTR with caveats

entries.research_question: What happens when Western-centric AI suggestions meet non-Western writers?
entries.main_finding: Indian participants shifted toward American styles in what and how; efficiency gains larger for Americans
entries.supports: cultural-preservation principle; never normalise to US English

entries.research_question: Do LLMs reduce collective creative diversity?
features: individual DSI vs collective diversity growth rate
entries.main_finding: Humans higher collective growth; GPT-4 homogenises across users even when individual outputs look diverse

entries.research_question: What makes documents work for readers? (standard)
entries.main_finding: Reader-task success over mechanical scores; 4 governing principles with guidelines

entries.venue: ASD-STE100 Issue 9 (2025-01-15), Standard for Technical Documentation
entries.research_question: Controlled language for safe translatable technical docs (standard)
entries.main_finding: Stable controlled language; Issue 9 refines terminology (ISO 1087-1:2019) and rules; STEMG warns AI can look STE-like without complying
entries.limitations: proprietary dictionary (do not redistribute); technical scope only
entries.supports: inspired vs verified split; never claim compliance without user dictionary+glossary
entries.does_not_justify: default STE style; heuristic compliance claims

entries.corpus_size: TOEFL vs native essays x7 detectors
entries.main_finding: Severe false-positive bias on evaluated non-native samples
entries.supports: fairness release condition; constrained style never a defect

entries.research_question: Limits of text-only detection under overlap+paraphrase?
entries.main_finding: Detection fragile under distribution overlap and editing
